meta.filing_channel: NRS Rev360 Self-Service Portal (IT Excel template)
meta.description: Canonical computation config: PBT -> CIT + Development Levy. The engine MUST select a rule set by year of assessment (YOA): YOA < 2026 uses the repealed CITA/TET/CGT regime (not in this config); YOA >= 2026 uses this config.

branches.note: Out of scope for this config.

company_classification.description: Run first. Gates CIT rate, Development Levy applicability, and ETR top-up.

SMALL.note: Both conditions must hold. Still files a full return.

REGULAR.rule: resident company that is not SMALL

etr_in_scope.description: Independent flag layered on top of class. Triggers s.57 15% minimum effective-tax-rate top-up.
carve_outs: Approved activities of a free-zone enterprise are excluded EXCEPT sales into the customs territory or where the entity is an MNE constituent under s.57(2)(a). [s.57(3)]

cit_rates.description: Applied to TOTAL PROFITS. Keep keyed by YOA + commencement order.

future_rate_change.trigger: Presidential order on the advice of the National Economic Council
future_rate_change.note: Not yet effective. Do not hardcode 30%; resolve rate by YOA against the commencement order.

development_levy.description: Applied to ASSESSABLE PROFITS (Stage D), NOT total profits. Consolidates former TET/NITDA/NASENI/etc.
development_levy.applies_when: companyClass == 'REGULAR' AND NOT isNonResident AND NOT isHydrocarbonAssessableProfit
exclusions: Assessable profits computed for hydrocarbon tax [s.59(4)]
development_levy.note: Capital allowances and loss relief do NOT reduce this base. A company can owe NGN 0 CIT and still owe Development Levy.

etr_topup.description: Domestic minimum top-up to a 15% effective tax rate. Only for etr_in_scope companies.

net_income.life_insurer_adjustment: Also exclude policyholders' gross income and investment income (s.57 proviso).

etr_topup.topup_formula: etr = coveredTaxes / netIncome ; topup = (etrInScope AND netIncome > 0 AND etr < 0.15) ? (0.15 * netIncome - coveredTaxes) : 0

general_minimum_tax.note: The legacy CITA turnover-based minimum tax is NOT carried into NTA 2025 for YOA 2026+. Functional floors are: SMALL @ 0%, 15% ETR (s.57), and sector-specific floors (e.g. s.18(6) 2% gross-revenue floor for non-resident shipping/air).

capital_allowances.description: Replace accounting depreciation. Reduce CIT only (via total profits); never reduce Development Levy.
capital_allowances.notional_retention_note: Record 1% of QCE for statistics until disposal (First Sched. para 6(a)); notional, does not change allowance claimable.

category_to_class_map.description: Maps Rev360 config!K2:K16 PPE/asset categories and common asset descriptions to a statutory class.
category_to_class_map._land_note: Land is not depreciable / not QCE on its own; exclude from capital allowances. Allocate building/works component to class 1.

rules.rule: Allowance only if at end of basis period the company OWNS the asset AND used it for the trade.
Acquisition + refurbishment/improvement cost bringing asset to first use.
QCE disqualified if VAT due but not charged, or import duty/levy not paid on the asset.
Priority-sector companies need Industrial Inspectorate certificate of acceptance for the QCE.
Pro-rate allowance to the taxable-use portion where asset only partly used to generate assessable profit.
Do NOT pro-rate where non-taxable income is < 10% of total income.
Pro-rate the allowance where the basis period is < 1 year (by days/365).
Hirer/lessee treated as owner; QCE limited to instalments paid excluding interest; lessor gets no allowance.
Lessor/owner claims the allowance as if used in its own trade.
Unutilised allowance carries forward to succeeding years until fully utilised.
CA subtracted from remainder of assessable profit AFTER loss relief.

capital_allowances.per_asset_pseudocode: class=mapCategoryToClass(asset.category); rate=table_I[class].rate; qce=asset.cost (ex disallowed FX/duty); residue=qce - cumulativeAllowanceClaimed; annual=min(rate*qce, residue - notional_retention_pct*qce); if basisPeriodDays<365: annual*=basisPeriodDays/365; if assetPartlyUsed AND nonTaxableIncomePct>=0.10: annual*=taxableUsePct; capitalAllowanceYOA += asset.inUseAtPeriodEnd ? annual : 0

loss_relief.description: Reduces CIT only (applied to assessable profit before capital allowances).

rules.time_limit_note: No cap; carry forward until fully recouped (legacy 4-year limit removed).

interest_restriction.description: Thin-cap / EBITDA rule. Excess connected-person interest is an add-back.
interest_restriction.treatment: Add back excessInterest; carry forward up to 5 YOA.
interest_restriction.exemption: Does NOT apply to a Nigerian subsidiary of a foreign bank or insurer (Third Sched. para 3).

computation_pipeline.description: Ordered stages A-K. starting_point and base outputs are critical.

stages.name: Add net chargeable gains for the YOA

tax_charge_addback_convention.description: Lock one convention. Mixing double-counts/under-counts tax.
tax_charge_addback_convention.START_FROM_PBT: Do NOT add back the income-tax provision (already below PBT). 'Taxes on profit or income' add-back = 0.
tax_charge_addback_convention.START_FROM_PAT: Rev360 template apparent design (PROFIT_ADJUSTMENT!D11 -> E765 = PAT). MUST add back full accounting tax charge (E764) to climb to PBT.

add_backs.description: Disallowable expenses. Maps to PROFIT_ADJUSTMENT rows 13-35.

items.label: Loss on disposal of fixed assets
Entertainment expenses (to the extent not allowed)
Expenditure on assets not used for the purpose of trade
Sum recoverable under an insurance or contract of indemnity
Taxes on profit or incomes
items.note: Only add back if starting from PAT. See computation_pipeline.tax_charge_addback_convention.

items.label: Related-party payments contravening Transfer Pricing Regulations
Expense allowable in determining chargeable gains
Penalty or fine imposed under any law
Expenses liable to VAT/import duty but not charged or paid
Compensating payments (securities lending) qualifying as dividend/interest
Tax or penalty borne on behalf of another person

computed_not_prelisted.label: General (non-specific) provisions e.g. general doubtful-debt provision
Excess over Naira equivalent at official CBN rate for foreign-currency expense

deductions.description: Non-taxable income removed / tax-only deductions added. Maps to PROFIT_ADJUSTMENT rows 40-49.

items.label: Profit on disposal of fixed assets
items.note: Capital; dealt with under chargeable gains.

items.label: Franked investment income (dividends already taxed)
items.note: Also excluded from ETR net income.

non_taxable_income_linkage.rule: If non-taxable revenue present (INCOME_STATEMENT!D631 > 0) THEN 'Expenses Relating To Non-taxable revenue' (INCOME_STATEMENT!D641) MUST be populated.
non_taxable_income_linkage.enforced_by: CHECK_BEFORE_UPLOAD progress gate (will not reach 100% otherwise).

chargeable_gains.description: CGT repealed; chargeable gains folded into income tax and taxed at the company's CIT rate (no separate 10% CGT).
chargeable_gains.basis: Net chargeable gains over chargeable assets disposed in the basis period (s.26(3))
chargeable_gains.rev360_source: Chargeable Assets Disposal Return (portal computes and posts to income-tax computation).
chargeable_gains.in_development_levy_base_note: FLAG G-B: s.59 levies on 'assessable profits'; s.27 separates gains. Default excluded; confirm with NRS guidance. Configurable.

selected_exemptions.label: Up to 2 private-use motor vehicles per YOA
Assets held in trust for charities

validation_rules.description: Hard rules that BLOCK upload/submission until satisfied.

rules.rule: CHECK_BEFORE_UPLOAD progress must equal 100%.
Revenue declared must equal revenue in audited P&L.
STATEMENT_OF_FINANCIAL_POSITION balances must equal audited balances.
Each expense on its own line item; reject single-bucket 'Other expenses' lumping.
If INCOME_STATEMENT!D631 > 0 then INCOME_STATEMENT!D641 (related expenses) must be populated.
Populate input cells only; do not alter embedded template formulas.
Audited FS PDF attached (auditor report, P&L, SFP, cash flows, changes in equity, notes, capital-allowance schedule) and ties to template.
USER_INPUT!D7 (ASSESSMENT YEAR) set; selects rule set (see meta.rule_set_selector).
Revenue entered against the correct sector block (one of 19 in config!C2:C20).
SMALL companies still file a full return despite 0% CIT and no levy.

do_not_use_as_tax_rates.rule: These are completion-bar weights, NOT tax rates. Never feed into tax math.

rev360_mapping.description: Input/output contract. Emit data in this shape; never alter formulas.

PROFIT_ADJUSTMENT.flag: FLAG G-D: D11 points at E765 (PAT), not PBT. See computation_pipeline.tax_charge_addback_convention.

STATEMENT_OF_FINANCIAL_POSITION.role: assets/liabilities/equity; must tie to audited accounts

portal_workflow: Fixed Assets Declaration (date, category, description, cost, depreciation)

configurable_flags.description: Items requiring tax-legal sign-off before go-live (rule book section 13). Defaults reflect the best statutory reading; make each configurable and reconcile against the live Rev360 preview.

development_levy_base_before_capital_all.note: true => levy on assessable profit BEFORE capital allowances and loss relief (s.59 read with s.27).

chargeable_gains_in_development_levy_bas.note: false => gains excluded from levy base; enter only at total-profits stage.

use_legacy_balancing_charge_allowance.note: false => use residue + chargeable-gains path on disposal; terms absent from the Act.

treat_check_before_upload_pct_as_progres.note: true => never treat 0.28/0.27/0.25/0.16/0.04 as tax rates.

rule_set_by_yoa.note: true => branch engine by YOA (pre-2026 legacy; 2026+ NTA 2025).

cit_rate_resolved_by_commencement_order.note: true => 30% until a Presidential order sets 25%; do not hardcode.

etr_turnover_threshold_ngn.note: NRS may raise by regulation (s.57(4)). EUR->NGN conversion convention for the EUR750m group test must be defined.

out_of_scope_sector_overrides.description: Override the standard chain; gate behind sector flags before coding. v1 targets the regular resident company.

regimes.statute: s.17, s.18 (2% gross-revenue floor for shipping/air)

worked_example.description: Regular company, YOA 2026. Illustrates the two distinct bases.
worked_example.classification: REGULAR (turnover NGN 2,000,000,000 > 100m; fixed assets 400m; not MNE; turnover < 50bn => not ETR_IN_SCOPE)
